notes:
Lyriix Android v0.2.10

- Swipe right across the main content to open the side menu. Swipe left/right across the mini-player to skip to the next/previous song. Seek bars, text fields, horizontal galleries, and vertical scrolling keep their normal gestures.
- Search all music from the toolbar or side menu, including while viewing Settings, Profile, or lyrics. Search matches title, artist, and album words together; Back returns to the previous view.
- Save up to 12 custom themes with their wallpaper, crop, dimming, and colors. Apply, rename, or delete saved themes in Appearance. Removing a saved theme keeps the currently applied appearance.
- Tap the microphone for voice commands such as pause, next song, shuffle on, repeat song, search, or play followed by a song name. A matching song plays directly; ambiguous matches show search results for you to choose.
- Speech uses your installed phone speech service and requests offline recognition where supported. That service may process audio online. Lyriix has no always-listening service, paid voice API, or new microphone permission. Typed commands are available if no speech service is installed.
- The headphone assistant button keeps its existing assistant assignment. Normal headset media controls continue through Android's media session.
- Music, account data, paired PC, queue restoration, and update signing remain compatible.
